meta.title: Silver — SGGW computer science student club
meta.description: The computer science student club at SGGW. We write the apps the campus uses.

hero.title: The computer science club at SGGW.
hero.lead: We write the apps the campus uses — and learn more from them than from classes.

steps.heading: How it works

items.title: Join the Discord
items.body: Everything is there: projects, dates, people. Introduce yourself in one sentence.

items.title: Pick a project or pitch your own
items.body: Join something already moving, or bring an idea and find two people for it.

items.title: Build it over the semester
items.body: In a small team, at your own pace. Every so often we meet in person in room 3/79.

steps.hackathons: We go to hackathons too. HackArena 3.0, March 2026: 4th place in the final.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.lead: Two of our apps are in the stores with over a thousand downloads each. The rest is on GitHub.

build.heading: What we build, and with what
build.what: Some of what we make solves problems we have at university ourselves — hence the timetable app and the campus map. The rest exists because someone wanted to try a new technology or do a familiar thing their own way.
build.how: There is no single stack. We pick tools per project and happily reach for new things — sometimes before anyone calls them stable.

join.heading: Join
join.lead: You don't need to know how to code yet. Wanting to build something is enough.
join.threshold: Join the Discord, introduce yourself, pick a project. In-person meetings are announced there.

companies.who: The Silver .NET computer science student club at the Faculty of Applied Informatics and Mathematics, SGGW. We build mobile and web apps — for the campus and for ourselves.
together: A workshop or talk for SGGW computer science students — we provide the room and the audience.
